<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M and M+2 pair with intensities roughly 100 % and 24 % (≈3:1), which is the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (Cl‑35/Cl‑37). No 1:1 M/M+2 pattern (bromine) or a small ~4 % M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Thus chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
